published.source: pending: round 70753 finals after A2's racials

summary: Deep Affliction with Siphon Life, Soul Siphon, Shadow Mastery and Wrack, Wrack channelled as the main spell (the 2026-11-02 notes doubled it).
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Racials on cooldown, except Troll Berserking
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom with more than 60s left, so it lands before the end
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9s left)
Immolate when it is down or ends within its cast time, with more than 15s left
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
Troll Berserking right before a Shadow Bolt, so the haste goes on cast spells, not instants
Siphon Life when it is down
Wrack while Corruption and the bane are both up
Shadow Bolt as the filler (instant on Nightfall procs)
caveats: Wrack's 86 a second and 0.286 coefficient are the development notes' values; client 1.60.1.70753 still has 36 and 0.143 (notes-only, standards 37).
How much of the warlock's stats a demon gets, and Succubus melee, come from pet sheets at levels 20 and 30, not 60.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era has 1.0). At 2.0, Shadow Bolt builds would lose about 4%. At 1.0, about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Shadow Bolt stops at rank IX, Immolate at VII and Corruption at VI. The books would add 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is active. The 5-piece added about 8 to 13 DPS on an older gear set.
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit, a reported Forever bug. It's worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: The Affliction request (warlock__affliction.json) with the Affliction Wrack talents and rotation (ui/warlock/apls/level60_affliction_wrack.apl.json); everything else as there. Request straight from mksettings -spec affliction -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_affliction -race Orc -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 30 (standards 33 since 2026-11-02, the longest range its spells reach; 25 from 2026-11-01, 5 before) and channelClipDelayMs 50, as the UI preset does. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Orc since 2026-11-02 (fairness-20261101-2), was Human: at 30 yd the Orc leads by 1.0 at 180 sec (20,000 iterations, seed 1, Orc 1013.6 against 1012.7); the Human stays the best Alliance race.
